courses.title: ToolTest 27 - Joint Limits
courses.objective: Apply motion limits to supported joints and verify movement stops at the configured bounds.

steps.title: Create a movable joint
steps.instructions: Create a revolute or slider joint between two components.
steps.expectedResult: A joint with one obvious motion degree of freedom.

checkpoint.expected: A joint with one obvious motion degree of freedom.

validationChecks: Joint moves in intended degree of freedom
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Set lower and upper limits
steps.instructions: Enable limits and enter a lower and upper range.
validationChecks: Lower and upper limits are stored on the joint
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Exercise the joint to lower bound
steps.learn: Exercise the joint to lower bound
steps.expectedResult: Motion stops at the configured lower bound.

checkpoint.expected: Motion stops at the configured lower bound.

validationChecks: Joint does not move past lower limit
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Exercise the joint to upper bound
steps.learn: Exercise the joint to upper bound
steps.expectedResult: Motion stops at the configured upper bound.

checkpoint.expected: Motion stops at the configured upper bound.

validationChecks: Joint does not move past upper limit
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
